desc: (deprecated) merges multiple Cachegrind output files into one
r: cg_merge - (deprecated) merges multiple Cachegrind output files into one
cg_merge sums together multiple Cachegrind output files into a single Cachegrind output file. It is deprecated because cg_annotate can now do much the same thing, but better.

-o outfile
Write the output to to outfile instead of standard output.
u: cg_merge - merges multiple Cachegrind output files into one
cg_merge sums together the outputs of multiple Cachegrind runs into a single output file.

-o outfile
Write the profile data to outfile rather than to standard output.
